sentences.en: He is quite good at his job, but lacks initiative.
sentences.zh: 他在工作中表现不错，但缺乏主动性。

sentences.en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
sentences.zh: 这个倡议显著提高了村民的生活质量。

sentences.en: A new initiative strives to minimize the number of accidents.
sentences.zh: 一项新的举措旨在减少事故数量。
